description: Build UNSIGNED transactions for an exact-in swap through Kairo's or Uniswap's route (route=best by default: the higher output; or kairo, or uniswap). Any two Arc tokens with a pool: tokenIn and tokenOut each take a 0x address or one of the symbols USDC, EURC, WETH, cirBTC, KAIRO, UBI (get_swap_tokens lists their addresses); ubi.fun coins and other tokens by address (get_coins finds ubi.fun coins). Steps, in order, from the swapper wallet: an exact ERC20 approve of the input to Permit2 and a Permit2 allowance for the Universal Router (exact amount, until the deadline), each only when missing and neither for USDC, which is paid as the transaction's value; then one Universal Router transaction. The minimum output is a fresh quote less slippageBps (default 100) and the deadline is 30 minutes out on chain time. This server never signs or submits; simulate each step first. For a ubi.fun coin, quote_swap and prepare_swap trade on the coin's own pool and pay your referrer; these routes pay no referrer and carry no note.

amount.description: The exact input in tokenIn units (for example "100" or "0.5")

route.description: best (default): the higher output, Uniswap on a tie; kairo or uniswap: that router only

slippageBps.description: How far below the quote the minimum output may be, in basis points (100 = 1%), 1 to 5000; default 100

swapper.description: The wallet that sends the steps and receives the output

tokenIn.description: A 0x address, or one of USDC, EURC, WETH, cirBTC, KAIRO, UBI

tokenOut.description: A 0x address, or one of USDC, EURC, WETH, cirBTC, KAIRO, UBI

name: prepare_token_swap
